source._comment: LIVE (official). KY SBE 'Current Voter Turnout' workbook linked from the elect.ky.gov home page: Documents/Absentee_Public_MMDDYY.xlsx (sheet DATA). Per county All/DEM/REP mail-in applications, sent, returned; excused and no-excuse in-person; FPCA applications/returned; TOTALS row checked. Non-D/R and FPCA -> oth. Falls back to the UF Election Lab stand-in if unreadable. Checked about hourly.
